where: landing page, checker setup, privacy policy, README

claim: Core scanning and CSV export work without an account
sandbox: fresh browser context opens /demo/, completes the scan, and downloads the free CSV without an account or sign-in control

claim: The public site uses no advertising or behavioral analytics requests

claim: Works offline after the first visit
sandbox: fresh browser context loads /demo/, waits for its service worker, goes offline, and reloads the demo shell
